item.title: Why Microsoft Entertainment Pack had a sticker announcing that it had Tetris?
item.description:
📝 There was a chance that the negotiations would fall through, and the Entertainment Pack would have to be released without Tetris. When the deal was completed, the “Now includes TETRIS for Windows. So I guess that means that if you have a copy of Microsoft Entertainment Pack for Windows with the Tetris sticker, you have an ultra-rare copy, like the original Windows 95 box with a hologram of a shirtless baby.
🔗 Read more: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20260818-00/?p=112621
